title: Two Voices
text: {who} says the wired ones talk like the AI now: the same pauses, the same words. Half the colony thinks it's beautiful. The other half wants them unplugged.

choices.label: Unplug them
choices.reply: The leads come out. The Devoted go quiet for a day.

choices.label: Leave them wired
choices.reply: They stay on the net. The drones run smoother; the colony runs a little colder.
